verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for a SaaS payments platform, so the axis applies. The evidence describes Highnote only as a hosted platform-as-a-service, with Highnote-run compliance and operations teams, and documents no self-hostable or on-premises deployment. An open-source-scoped Node.js SDK is a client library, not the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
